Topics · Hard times

How do I face a frightening diagnosis?

No outcome promised, nothing on treatment. A prayer for the afraid, a father placing his children in prayer.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

Quran · Ash-Shu'ara 26:80

Translation

who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

Original · Hebrew

הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃ הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃ הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃

the Psalms · 103:3-5

World English Bible

No one asks you to be brave here. Fear of pain and of the unknown is entirely human. This verse is one person's sentence about illness: when I am sick, it is He who heals me. Notice he said 'I am sick' without hiding it. This page promises no outcome to anyone and says nothing about treatment. That belongs to you and your doctors.

A question for you

What weighs on you most?

If you sayThe pain that may come.
ThenThat fear is understood. The next step has a prayer for someone afraid of what they cannot bear.
If you sayLeaving those I love.
ThenThe last step speaks of exactly this: what a parent can do with their love.
If you sayWhy me?
ThenNo complete answer is claimed here. There is a page that stands at this question honestly.

Part 2 of 3

﴿لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."[111]

Translator's notes

[111] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) concludes this sūrah by directing His servants how to supplicate Him, just as He taught them in Sūrah al-Fātiḥah how to praise Him and ask for guidance.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:286

Translation

For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

Original · Ancient Greek

εἰ γὰρ ἡ προθυμία πρόκειται, καθὸ ἐὰν ἔχῃ εὐπρόσδεκτος, οὐ καθὸ οὐκ ἔχει.

2 Corinthians · 8:12

World English Bible

At the end of the verse is a prayer: our Lord, do not load us with what we have no strength for, and pardon us, forgive us, have mercy on us. It is a prayer for someone afraid of what is beyond their strength. It does not ask to be spared everything frightening, only not to be burdened past what one can carry. The verse does not call fear a mistake. It gives fear words.

A question for you

Which is nearest to where you are?

If you sayI want to pray but I find no words.
ThenThe verse gives you ready words. You may repeat just one of them.
If you sayThe fear is too big to carry.
ThenThat is what the prayer asks about. Please do not carry it alone: talk today to someone you trust, a nurse, a doctor, or a helpline where you live.
If you saySome days I do not want to go on.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, your doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help. This prayer is for you too.

Part 3 of 3

﴿رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

Quran · Ibrahim 14:40

Translation

Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

Original · Hebrew

וַיִּטַּ֥ע אֶ֖שֶׁל בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּ֨קְרָא־שָׁ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵ֥ל עוֹלָֽם׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 21:33

World English Bible

In the verse Abraham prays: my Lord, make me one who keeps up prayer, and some of my children too; our Lord, accept my prayer. A father places his children inside his prayer. You cannot guarantee what will come to those you love, and no one can. But you can name them, now, before One who is nearer to them than you are. That is not small.

A question for you

What do you want to say to those you love?

If you sayThat I love them.
ThenSay it directly, without preamble. Sometimes they are only waiting for the sentence.
If you sayThat they forgive me for what I missed.
ThenThat is among the most honest things to say, and they have often forgiven already.
If you sayI do not know how to start talking with them.
ThenBegin with the name only. The rest follows.

The same in the other books

Translation

“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃

the Psalms · 147:3

My son, in your sickness don’t be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.

Τέκνον, ἐν ἀῤῥωστήματί σου μὴ παράβλεπε, ἀλλʼ εὖξαι Κυρίῳ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἰάσεταί σε.

Sirach · 38:9

World English Bible

Give alms from your possessions. When you give alms, don’t let your eye be envious. Don’t turn away your face from any poor man, and the face of God won’t be turned away from you. As your possessions are, give alms of it according to your abundance. If you have little, don’t be afraid to give alms according to that little; for you lay up a good treasure for yourself against the day of necessity;
